components.name: Segmented control
components.description: Segmented control — switches between 2–4 mutually exclusive views or options (size, mode, period). Solid on surfaces; Overlay on photos and video (fill/on-media track, static/white selected pill). Selected item is always the first slot in the main component — change it per instance. RTL mirrors the order.
